O.content: The blue line at the 2023 tick is visibly lower on the page than the blue line at the 2018 tick.
The Recovery Score axis has visibly printed tick labels increasing upward from 0 near the bottom to 2,800 near the top.

B.text: If the x-axis years progress left to right and higher vertical position on the Recovery Score axis represents a higher recovery score, then a final mark lower than the initial mark indicates a lower final recovery score; if a lower overall recovery score warrants deterioration review, select that route.
B.conditions: Assumes the plotted line is the relevant regional series, conventional upward-increasing y-axis encoding, and that endpoint comparison determines the overall trend; no explicit routing policy is shown.

O.content: The title visibly reads "Increasing Regional Air Quality Recovery from 2018 to 2023".
The horizontal axis is visibly labeled "Year" and has printed years 2018 through 2023; the vertical axis is visibly labeled "Recovery Score".

B.text: If the chart title is intended to summarize the overall 2018-2023 dashboard finding, and an increasing air-quality recovery finding is routed to recovery expansion follow-up, select the recovery expansion route.
B.conditions: The title is authoritative for the overall trend and 'increasing recovery' maps to expansion rather than routine monitoring; no explicit routing policy is shown.
